$comment: Recorded baselines for the cross-server routing eval (#205 Part 2). A router with an entry here is compared against it and fails the run on regression; a router with no entry reports `unmeasured` and does not fail. Adding an entry requires an actual run — see $unmeasured below.

lexical.note: The deterministic control: the fleet's own shipped scorer (packages/shared/src/utils/tool-search.ts) pointed at the merged 314-tool catalog instead of one server's registry. Measured by running it, not estimated. This is the floor — 35% accuracy, and it calls a destructive tool on 2 of 3 requests that name no platform at all. Any model number is only meaningful against this.

anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.reason: No model run has happened. The harness was authored in an environment with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY — api.anthropic.com is reachable (an unauthenticated probe returns 401, not a proxy 403), but no credential is available, so nothing was measured.
anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.howToRecord: Run `node evals/run-cross-server-routing.mjs --router=anthropic --out=report.json` with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, read the summary, and add a `routers` entry above with those numbers and the date of the run. Do not backdate `measuredAt`, and do not record a baseline from a run whose failures you have not read — a baseline is a statement that this is the standard, not just the last number seen.
anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.$why: Writing a plausible accuracy here would be exactly the confidently-wrong claim #203 removed from the manifest and #202 removed from the platform-facts ledger. An unmeasured router reports `unmeasured` and exits 0; it never silently passes as measured.
